$comment: Suggested response shape for GET /agent/statistics?view=day&period=today. Raw numbers only — the client formats. Percentages are NOT sent: they are derived in the client from documented formulas.

comparison.$comment: Deltas against the immediately preceding period of the same view.

$notes.rto: Bundles return-to-origin and door-to-origin. Do not split these in the UI and do not include cancellations here.
$notes.hasActivity: When false the client shows the empty state rather than a page of zeroes.
$notes.availablePeriods: Server-owned so the three-month cap cannot be bypassed from the client. For view=month, send the current month and the two preceding it, newest last.
